intro: Uzzek is a battle-hardened orc veteran stationed just southwest of the Far Watch Post in the Barrens. Having survived countless skirmishes across Kalimdor, he now helps evaluate and temper promising Horde warriors who journey through the arid plains.

p: Perched southwest of Far Watch Post along the eastern border of the Barrens, Uzzek represents the enduring grit of the Horde's frontline fighters. Having endured brutal combat throughout the recent wars, he serves as an instructor and trial-giver to younger warriors seeking to master their defensive disciplines. To prove oneself to Uzzek requires testing one's mettle against the savage wildlife and raiders that plague the arid crossing.
